_comment: The gate treats 'zero failures' as success, so a run that silently skips tests
reports PASS having tested less than it should have. These counts make an
unexpected skip a failure instead of silence.
Raising a number here is a deliberate, reviewable act. If a band exceeds its
baseline, the default assumption is a real regression. Update the baseline only
once you know why the new skip is correct, and say so in the PR.

parallel.why: No test skips. Every test in the Unit and Integration suites runs.
